mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 220.0), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 220.0), the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market that supports higher corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 550,000 units, it signals a weakening in the residential sector and broader economic demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 550.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and increase in payrolls signals a weakening manufacturing sector despite a strong labor market, indicating economic fragility that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls and PAYEMS rises, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 100.0, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
